inductees.title: Hold Timers 178.3, Mailing It In 177.6
inductees.subtitle: Week 3, 2019
inductees.stat: 355.9 combined · highest-scoring game in FBP history
inductees.blurb: Two of the five biggest scores the league has ever seen, in the same game, decided by 0.7. Mailing It In's 177.6 is still the most points ever scored in a loss. Alvin Kamara (37.1), Darren Waller (27.1) and Julio Jones (26.8) outlasted Mark Ingram (35.5), Cooper Kupp (33.1) and Greg Olsen (25.5), and Hold Timers went on to win the 2019 title.
